ice.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: ONE small hanging ice cluster for the lower branches of cartoon game trees. Three short chunky tapered ICICLES, different lengths, attached to one small shallow strip of white snow across their top. Main icicle in middle slightly longer, neighboring two short. Simple bold friendly shapes, not thin sharp realistic needles. Glossy PALE CYAN BLUE ice with a cool blue-violet shaded side, one broad opaque creamy white highlight on each icicle, restrained detail, clean hand-painted cartoon finish. Front-facing flat sprite suitable to hang by its top from a branch. Entire object visible, centered with generous transparent margins. Only this one cluster. No tree, branch, foliage, rocks, pedestal, ground, backdrop, snowflakes, particles, cast shadow, halo, glow, text, or extra objects. Genuine alpha-zero TRANSPARENT background, opaque clean artwork. Near square framing.
